prompt: Create a polished pixel-art game art direction sheet for an original white-hatted museum traveler in an isometric microarchitecture portfolio called pixelcao. Wide landscape sheet, dark teal #222C30 background, muted sage stone platforms, warm cream robe and tall tapered white hat with small square brim, dark featureless face under brim, tiny dark boots. Quiet original character, not a replica of any named game character. Visible crisp pixel clusters, limited palette, flat 3-tone shading, no metallic reflections, no PBR gloss, no realistic blur. TOP HALF: three large views of the SAME small white traveler front-three-quarter, side walking, back-three-quarter, consistent hat and robe, little blocky arms. LOWER HALF: four storyboard panels connected with small arrows: idle beside a stone project island; walking up stepped bridge with one foot raised; planted feet and raised arm casting a few amber square sparks toward miniature server racks; an amber square doorway unfolding into a large warm ivory project detail panel with simplified masonry images. Include tiny concise labels only 'IDLE', 'WALK', 'CAST', 'OPEN'. Environment coherent with true 2:1 isometric pixel museum, beautifully composed simple stone bricks, architecture supports walkable surfaces. Character should read at 40-60 screen pixels, hat remains dominant readable silhouette. Art direction reference, no fake statistics or extra UI, no HUD, no coins or game enemies. High quality pixel art, deliberate geometric craft.
